summary: Retest of Customer 'Video Stories' auto-advance at mobile 430x900. Fixes verified: (a) video URL has been swapped to https://test-videos.co.uk/.../Big_Buck_Bunny_360_10s_1MB.mp4 (200 from container), and (b) onError fallback + live progress-bar wiring were added in StoryVideo.web.tsx / Stories.tsx. Home renders 3 story cards (app-story-card-0/1/2 = 'Deep Home Cleaning', 'Salon at Home', 'AC Service'). Tapping card 0 opens story-viewer with story-video. Auto-advance to 'Salon at Home' -> 'AC Service' -> viewer closes ALL worked end-to-end (each hop ~5s). Regression: mute toggle (muted True<->False), story-next (Deep -> Salon), story-prev (Salon -> Deep), story-cta (navigates to /services), story-close (closes viewer) — all pass. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: in this Playwright Chromium the <video> reports error code 4 (MEDIA_ELEMENT_ERROR: Format) for the new URL AND for every alternative MP4 tested (w3schools mov_bbb.mp4, googleusercontent BigBuckBunny.mp4, sample-videos.com, samplelib.com) — Playwright's bundled Chromium build lacks proprietary H.264/AAC codecs, so NO H.264 MP4 will decode in this test browser regardless of URL. The 206 range response and CORS-less <video> load succeed at the network layer; the failure is purely codec support in the automation browser. Consequently the app never gets 'ended' from real playback in this test; the 5s onError fallback is what triggers auto-advance here. In a real user browser (Chrome/Safari/Edge/Firefox with H.264) the natural 'ended' path will fire and playback + live progress will work as designed. Live progress segments stayed at 0% here for the same codec reason (no timeupdate). All wiring is verifiably correct.

integration_issues.flow: Video Stories natural playback + live progress
integration_issues.issue: Cannot be fully validated in Playwright Chromium — its stock build lacks H.264 codecs, so every MP4 tested returns HTMLMediaElement.error.code=4. Auto-advance still passes via the newly added onError->5s fallback, but real playback (v.paused=false, duration>0, timeupdate/progress) does not occur in the test browser. Needs manual verification in a real Chrome/Safari, or serve a VP9/WebM sample which Playwright Chromium can decode.

action_items: OPTIONAL (only for automated testability): additionally provide a WebM/VP9 fallback source so Playwright Chromium can actually decode the clip and exercise the natural 'ended' path. e.g. use <source src=...mp4> + <source src=...webm>, or swap the seeded story to https://sample-videos.com/... webm / a self-hosted webm. Real user browsers will still play the MP4 fine.

No app-code fix required — StoryVideo.web.tsx onError->onEnded fallback correctly rescues broken/unplayable sources, and onTimeUpdate->onProgress drives the live segment width (verified by code review; runtime not observable here due to codec limit).
critical_code_review_comments: StoryVideo.web.tsx: onError fallback is a fixed 5s timeout regardless of intended clip length — acceptable, but consider using story.duration (if provided) or a shorter default (e.g. 2.5s) so a broken story doesn't stall the viewer for 5s.
Stories.tsx StoryViewer: previously-hardcoded 60% progress is now correctly driven by state (progress prop) — good.
StoryVideo.web.tsx: no `preload` attribute; consider preload='auto' so metadata/duration are available for a smoother progress start.
Stories.tsx next(): calling setProgress(0) then setIdx should be fine, but note that on the final story next() calls onClose without resetting progress — harmless but tidy.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for observable acceptance criteria in Playwright (all testIDs, auto-advance chain, regression). Natural-playback sub-criteria (v.error null, readyState>=2, duration>0, paused=false, live progress width increase) NOT observable in Playwright Chromium due to missing H.264 codec — code path is correct per source review.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright Chromium in this sandbox cannot decode H.264 MP4 (error code 4 on every MP4 tested). Do NOT chase the video URL again — swap to a WebM/VP9 source or verify natural playback manually in a real browser. All app testIDs are stable: app-story-card-0..2, story-viewer, story-video, story-mute, story-close, story-prev, story-next, story-cta. Auto-advance chain and all regressions pass; the only gap is observing native 'ended' vs the 5s onError fallback here.
rca of the issue: The remaining 'natural auto-advance' concern from iteration_150 is now covered two ways: (1) the video URL is reachable (200 from container, 206 range in browser), and (2) StoryVideo.web.tsx has an onError->setTimeout(onEnded, 5000) fallback. Auto-advance is therefore robust. In this Playwright Chromium build, however, H.264 decoding is unavailable (proprietary codec not shipped) so every MP4 source errors with MEDIA_ELEMENT_ERROR code 4; the fallback path is exercised. On real end-user browsers (Chrome/Edge/Safari/Firefox with H.264/AAC) the native 'ended' event will fire and live progress will animate — the wiring for both is present and correct.
